title: Honor’s Robot Phone is better than a gimbal in a phone has any right to be
summary: After an hour of testing the Robot Phone, I’m surprised but impressed. The gimbal camera will spend most of its life tucked inside the phone’s camera module, protected by a small plastic screen.
